story_type: sport fishing boat on fire offshore with people still aboard, Navy small boat and Coast Guard crews alongside
hook: 17 miles out, this boat was burning with people aboard.
narration: Seventeen miles off Point Loma, a boat was on fire with people still aboard.
Other boaters in the area came in close to help.
Smoke poured out of the cabin while a man stood on the back deck.
A Navy ship nearby put its small boat in the water, the fastest way to get sailors alongside.
Navy sailors and Coast Guard crews pulled up to the burning boat.
Together they got the fire out and went to work on the two people aboard.
outcome: Both of them were brought back safely to San Diego.

location_card.place: 17 miles west of Point Loma, Calif.

title: Boat on fire, 17 miles off San Diego
description:
U.S. Navy and Coast Guard crews and other boaters worked together to rescue two people from a burning boat about 17 miles west of Point Loma, California, in July 2014. The fire was extinguished and both were taken safely back to San Diego.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video by Sector San Diego, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/352545/two-rescued-boat-fire
